name: Instantly AI
body:
> Tool · 2026-10-01

# Summary
Instantly AI is the cold-email outreach platform TAG uses. Its API key is wired into Claude Code through `C:\TAG Marketing Claude\.env` as `INSTANTLY_API_KEY` [redacted, never opened or printed].

# Access facts
- Works with the **v1 API only**; v2 rejects the key. There is no MCP connector.
- Meetings and opportunities are only visible in the Instantly UI.
- Security pending: the key was pasted in a chat on Jun 24, 2026; Kim should rotate it and update `.env`.

# Usage history
- **Alphalete outreach:** a May campaign sent 764 emails for 2 replies. The "June 2026 - Alphalete Trenchless" campaign targeted school districts and facilities and got 2 "Interested" replies: North Park School District R-1 (planning a sewer lining bid, a real lead) and Englewood Public Schools (low fit). No outreach activity recorded after late June. Lead exports and reply threads sit in an `instantly-outreach-2026-06-24\` folder under Alphalete (personal contact data, not summarized).
- Follow-up noted in the Alphalete handoff: check for or draft a follow-up to North Park School District R-1.
- Design reference: the [SEO Tracker](lib:brain-seo-tracker) and [AIO SEO CRM](lib:brain-aio-seo-crm) shells were styled "Instantly-style".
- The [AI SEO Masterclass](lib:brain-ai-seo-masterclass) case study on a local agency used Instantly for cold email to med spas.
